title: A Novel Non-Equiatomic (W35Ta35Mo15Nb15)95Ni5 Refractory High Entropy Alloy with High Density Fabricated by Powder Metallurgical Process
process_description: prepared by mechanical alloying (MA) of elemental W, Ta, Mo, Nb, and Ni powders (purity >99.9%, diameter <5 µm) in a high-energy planetary ball mill at 300 rpm for 12 h with a ball-to-powder ratio of 10:1 under argon atmosphere, followed by spark plasma sintering (SPS) at 1700°C for 10 min under 30 MPa pressure.
